name: Fiddleback Venom
body:
Price 500 gp

DETAILS

Type poison (injury, ingested); Save Fortitude DC 13; Onset 1 minute; Frequency 1/minute for 6 minutes; Cure 2 saves

EFFECT

Initial Effect: nauseated 1d4 rounds

Secondary Effect: 1d3 Str damage and 1d4 Con damage
